lines.title: Semantic Router dot net isn't just for Claude Code. This one's GitHub Copilot C L I. Every prompt goes to the cheapest model that can handle it, and Copilot works just like before.
lines.connect: Copilot C L I can use your own model provider. Point it at the router: its address, any key, and semantic router as the model. Add the context window, so Copilot knows when to compact. Then start copilot as usual.
lines.hello: A simple question goes to a small local model. It's free, and it never leaves your machine.
lines.code: A small coding task? The local coder takes it.
lines.hard: But a hard debugging question goes to a frontier model, on a subscription you already pay for.
lines.local: Working on something private? Start the message with at-local, and the rest of the conversation stays on this machine.
lines.live: Every turn is on the dashboard, next to your other tools: which route matched, which model answered, and why.
lines.end: That's Semantic Router dot net with Copilot. It's open source and MIT licensed, and it works with the tools you already use.
